intentions.title: Enforce a hard multi-tenant boundary across every entrypoint (flat + workspace/project-scoped URLs, sockets, plugin routes) via a single small family of composable Plug pipelines
intentions.evidence: router.ex defines paired :api/:scoped_api, :browser/:scoped_browser, :media_mutate/:scoped_media_mutate pipelines; ResolveWorkspace/ResolveProject membership-gate every scoped route; AssignDefaultScope is a documented back-compat shim for flat routes inferring the seeded Default workspace; scoped mirrors exist for plugin admin/public/ops/api buckets (scope "/w/:workspace_slug/p/:project_slug/...").

intentions.title: Let anonymous, read-only visitors reach specific published content (papers, docs, media) through explicit share grants, never through a broadened default posture
intentions.evidence: router.ex pipelines :shared_docs_api, :shared_media_api, :shared_paper_browser, :shared_studio_browser all insert RequireShareScope(surface: ...) before the membership-gating resolvers, documented as no-ops when the scope isn't shared; live_scope.ex's authorize_read/4 has explicit :share_read grade and attach_readonly_gate/2 halts all mutating LiveView events for a share-graded socket.

intentions.title: Allow externally granted, sub-scoped access (airdrop grants) to read and write narrowly-scoped content without ever widening beyond the grant, additive to membership
intentions.evidence: router.ex :api_grant_read pipeline (ResolveTokenOwner + AssignGrantScope) layered only on flat READ routes; live_scope.ex grant_read_ctx/2, has_write_grant?/2, attach_write_gate/2 and write_target/3 implement per-event write-target containment via Access.validate/3, explicitly ordered last so grants only add access.

intentions.title: Keep the API and Studio fully self-serviceable by plugins through a compile-time route-injection macro, so plugins get first-class auth tiers (admin/ops/public/api/token/ingest/public_api/github_webhook/ticket_key/session_token_root/public_root) without touching the host router by hand
intentions.evidence: router.ex imports BarkparkWeb.Router.Plugins and calls plugin_routes(scope: ...) across ~12 distinct auth-tier scopes (admin, public, ops, api, token, public_api, github_webhook, token_root, session_token_root, ticket_key, public_root, ingest), each documented as dormant-until-a-plugin-contributes; scoped mirrors duplicate several of these under /w/:ws/p/:proj.

intentions.title: Provide a session-cookie-aware auth ladder (Bearer token, login session, share-edit token, ticket key, ingest shared-secret) so browser, API-client, and low-trust submitter callers each get the minimum-privilege credential path without cross-contamination
intentions.evidence: router.ex comments distinguish OptionalToken (Bearer-only) vs OptionalSessionToken (Bearer-or-cookie) vs RequireBearerOrSessionToken (CSRF-checked cookie branch) vs session_token_root (GET-only, no-CSRF-header cookie navigation) vs ticket_key/ingest (shared-secret, no tenancy); live_auth.ex on_mount(:admin/:ops/:fetch_api_token) mirrors the same ladder for LiveView mounts, with authorize_user/3 falling back to Tenancy.Auth.authorize for account-session admins.

intentions.title: Give operators a single-workspace admin/settings surface (SettingsLive, org-admin, styleguide, tmux console, Claude chat) reachable at both a stable flat URL and its scope-canonical URL, redirecting the flat spelling once scoped
intentions.evidence: router.ex AdminStudioRedirectController 302s /studio/settings to /w/:ws/p/:proj/studio/settings (sdl-w1-admin-canonical); scoped_admin_studio live_session with LiveScope.:resolve; org-admin/styleguide/tmux/chat kept flat as genuinely scope-free; StudioChrome shared top-bar hook composed onto every admin-gated live_session.

intentions.title: Preserve one theme identity attribute on every rendered HTML surface (Studio, papers, swatch) without disturbing byte-identical output for the default theme
intentions.evidence: layouts.ex bp_theme_attr/1 returns nil (omitting the attribute) when assigns[:bp_theme] equals the default theme or is unset, otherwise emits the workspace's resolved theme id for [data-bp-theme=...] CSS to key off.

intentions.title: Keep search-quality telemetry (actor/session identity, tags, tentative/committed recording) uniformly derivable from request headers across every API surface that touches search
intentions.evidence: search_intel.ex centralizes actor_key/session_key/parent_event_id/tags/should_record? parsing from x-bp-search-* headers, with should_record? distinguishing client-tracked (needs explicit commit header) vs untracked (record by default) requests and defensive parse_period_start/1 clauses fixing a prior anonymous-request 500.
